results.question: Who wrote Romeo and Juliet?
results.response: "Romeo and Juliet" is a play written by William Shakespeare. It was first performed in 1595, and it has remained in print and widely performed ever since. The play is set in the early 1590s in the city of London, in a city where the English Wars of the Roses were taking place. The story revolves around the love of two young lovers, one named Romeo and the other Juliet, who are in love with each other but are also in love with their respective families and with one another at the same time. The play explores themes of love, betrayal, and grief, as well as the lengths to which people will go to obtain their desires.
